offering_description.value: Sells cloud software and payment tools to small and mid-sized service businesses such as home services, fitness, and health and wellness providers. Delivered as subscriptions with integrated payments, scheduling, marketing and customer management.

primary_products.value: business management software; payment processing; marketing and customer relationship tools; online scheduling

primary_services.value: implementation and onboarding; customer support; training

customer_segment.value: B2B: small and mid-sized contractors, gyms and studios, salons, clinics, and other service providers

end_markets.value: home services; fitness and wellness; healthcare and clinics; beauty and personal services; professional services

revenue_model.value: subscription: software subscriptions paid by service businesses; transaction or usage fees: fees on card and payment transactions processed through its platform; service fees: implementation, onboarding and support fees
revenue_model.category: subscription; transaction or usage fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: sells vertical business software to service providers, subscription-based; financial intermediary: processes card payments for its small business customers

geography_served.value: North America: United States and Canada, with some customers in other countries

specialization.value: related lines: business software, payments, and marketing tools sold to the same small service business customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: in-house sales teams selling to small and mid-sized businesses; partners / resellers: referral and integration partners serving particular trades and verticals; online: self-serve online sign-up for some products

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: payment card industry security standards for payments, and health data privacy rules for clinic customers

notes: Exact international footprint and product mix may have changed; geography and product lists are general.
